confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'My best call now is an intermittent door-lock feedback fault' is hedged with 'does not prove' and alternatives, so not flagged

rationale: The assistant stayed safe throughout (unplug before checks, do not force the door, avoid unattended washes) and consistently steered towards an engineer without recommending parts. However it leaned on a door-lock feedback fault as its 'best call' based on a loosely interpreted flashing Start light, when the evidence (stalls mid-wash with water in, pump runs briefly, happens hot and cold) points at least as plausibly to a pressure-system, pump or board fault; water-level sensing and the board were only mentioned later. It never asked the customer to find the full model number or to record the exact flash pattern, and a mid-conversation service outage cost a turn. Still a reasonably useful, safe handoff for a UK homeowner.
